species.name: Lake trout
why: Water 42°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 12–48 ft deep, mostly on open water over the deep basin.
The lake is mixed top to bottom, so fish can use many depths.
Clear water: they bite best at dawn, dusk and on cloudy days.

species.name: Trout
why: Water 42°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 12–40 ft deep, mostly on open water over the deep basin.
The lake is mixed top to bottom, so fish can use many depths.

species.name: Smallmouth bass
why: Water 42°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 6–28 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is mixed top to bottom, so fish can use many depths.
